title: A control plane for work continuity
narration: When production work fails, the important question is what happened next. Fluxera makes that answer visible, accountable, and verifiable.

title: Command center
narration: The command center brings service health, pending human decisions, queue pressure, cost exposure, and the live execution stream into one operational view.

title: Five layers, one execution stream
narration: Agent runs, API calls, workflows, tools, and memory operations share one metadata-only event model. Each row keeps status, duration, and direct cost in context.

title: Find the checkpoint
narration: Open an execution to see its step trail. Here, document indexing failed after a saved checkpoint. The cursor tells an approver where a supported resume can begin.

title: A person decides
narration: Fluxera creates a recovery request, but it does not act on a customer system by itself. An authorized approver reviews the evidence and decides.

title: Decision recorded
narration: Approval is recorded before any external action. The request then enters a durable dispatch queue, so a worker restart does not erase it.

title: Signed, idempotent dispatch
narration: The worker sends a signed webhook to the configured recovery receiver, with a recovery identifier and idempotency key. Delivery is only a handoff.

title: Verification needs evidence
narration: Fluxera marks recovery verified only after a linked SDK execution reports the outcome. A successful webhook response alone never proves that the work resumed.

title: An auditable trail
narration: The audit view preserves the request, human decision, dispatch state, and final verification as separate events. The story remains inspectable later.

title: Cost intelligence
narration: Cost intelligence separates observed spend and retry waste from estimated avoidable cost. In this pilot, these are recommendations, never automatic suppression of customer work.

title: Your recovery receiver
narration: Integrations connect approved actions to customer-controlled recovery endpoints. Each receiver must declare support for idempotency keys before it can be activated.

title: Observe. Approve. Recover. Verify.
narration: That is Fluxera: a live continuity workspace where people stay in control and results are verified. Explore the pilot at getfluxera dot com.
